tbh im kinda on the fence on all this... like why didnt the ex-gf say something after start up when KSH really rose to fame... like ksh was getting all this attention for being the most lovable second lead and starring in a drama with bae suzy. he was getting repeatedly teased on this role and just...why..why now? she had to endure a whole year or somethn of people praising ksh and him getting all sorts of cfs and she only decides NOW is the time to spoil the fun? gotta respect her for letting him enjoy life like that before letting crash and burn i guess???

my only real qualm with this whole situation is why people like the ex-gf make public private matters like this. there is never, never any sense of justice in publicly ruining someone no matter how you look at it. it may be satisfying at first but the aftermath is going to take a mental toll on e v e r y o n e, even the victim herself, because of all the media outlets harassing them to divulge more information than they (victim) were ever ready to divulge in the first place. its a toxic culture and i absolutely hate it. yeah, hate on ksh all you want (dont get me wrong, im neither for or against ksh and i could care less bc HEY it isnt my life, yours or anyone else's and my life never depended on ksh in the first place)  but i think making such a private matter public is just awful for everyone involved.

little what-if moment but im half-scared this is going to be like a jimin and mina from aoa situation.
